definitions: prepare (written material) for publication by correcting, condensing, or otherwise modifying it.
supervise the publication of (a newspaper, magazine, or other periodical).
prepare (a film or recording) by cutting and rearranging.
change or correct (data or a text) on a computer.
examples: I'll edit your article for grammar and spelling.
The director edited the film for its television release.
You can edit the document directly in the browser.
